listings.title: Tirana Historic Center, Skanderbeg Square & Dajti Mountain
listings.description: Vibrant Albanian capital featuring Skanderbeg Square, Et'hem Bey Mosque, Clock Tower, Bunk'Art 2 museum, Murat Toptani Street, Tirana Castle, New Bazaar, and panoramic views from Mount Dajti cable car.

listings.title: Berat UNESCO 'City of a Thousand Windows' & Kala Fortress
listings.description: UNESCO World Heritage gem on the Osum River. Explore the ancient Mangalem Quarter, the hilltop Berat Castle (Kala), Onufri Iconographic Museum, historic Gorica Bridge, and scenic riverside promenade.

listings.title: Gjirokastër Stone Fortress, Old Bazaar & Ottoman Mansions
listings.description: Dramatic hillside UNESCO stone town featuring the massive Gjirokastër Castle, the cobblestone Old Bazaar (Qafa e Pazarit), and preserved 18th-century Ottoman fortified mansions including Skënduli House and Zekate House.

listings.title: Syri i Kaltër (The Blue Eye) Natural Spring Sanctuary
listings.description: A mesmerizing hypnotic natural phenomenon with crystal-clear turquoise spring water bubbling up from unknown depths beneath emerald oak trees, followed by sunset strolls along the lively Sarandë Promenade.

listings.title: Ksamil Riviera Azure Clifftop Suites & 4 Islands Lagoon
listings.description: Premier boutique waterfront retreat directly overlooking Bora Bora Beach and Beach 7 in Ksamil. Features private island boat transfers, panoramic sea-view balconies, private infinity pool, and fresh Mediterranean breakfast.

listings.title: Butrint UNESCO National Archaeological Park & Sanctuary
listings.description: Ancient Greek, Roman, Byzantine, and Venetian ruins nestled on a tranquil peninsula surrounded by Lake Butrint and the Vivari Channel. Features a preserved amphitheater, Roman baptistery, basilica, and Venetian castle.

listings.title: Drymades Coast Clifftop Dining & Porto Palermo Grills
listings.description: Exquisite seaside dining on the Albanian Riviera coast. Enjoy freshly grilled sea bass, wild octopus, Byrek, sheep cheeses from Llogara Pass, and local Shesh i Zi wines with cliffside views over the Ionian Sea.
